summary: Cool slate, one teal signal colour, 4px radius, 32px rows
description: mxcli's default styling. Atlas Core is untouched: the theme is a token block in theme/web/custom-variables.scss plus one partial imported from theme/web/main.scss, so a generated app stays upgradable across Mendix releases and is re-brandable by editing a single colour.

files.purpose: Layer 1 — brand tokens Atlas reads (palette, type, shape, density)
Layer 2 — @font-face, focus ring, touch density, recipe classes
one @import line — this file compiles last, so the partial wins the cascade
vendored IBM Plex Sans + Mono (SIL OFL 1.1) — no CDN at runtime
